THERE WAS AN EVACUATION OF VISITING STUDENTS FROM THE BUILDING (EXACT NUMBERS ARE UNKNOWN). Report Description/// THIS IS AN PHMSA 48-HOUR UPDATE TO NRC REPORT 1409845 /// THE UPDATE IS AS FOLLOWS: THE CALLER STATED THAT A BORING TOOL THAT UTILIZES AMMUNITION WAS BEING USED TO INSTALL A FIBER OPTIC CONDUIT. BECAUSE OF THIS THE ROUND FROM THE TOOL RUPTURED A PLX GAS SERVICE LINE. WHEN THE BULLET WAS REMOVED FROM THE LINE A RUPTURE OCCURRED RELEASING NATURAL GAS INTO THE ATMOSPHERE. ACCORDING TO THE CALLER WITHIN MINUTES OF THE RUPTURE AND AFTER THE BULLET WAS REMOVED THE MATERIAL IGNITED. A WALL WITHIN PROXIMITY TO THE RELEASE CAUGHT FIRE. THE CALLER ALSO UPDATED THE SRP INFORMATION, WHICH WILL BE REFLECTED IN THE APPROPRIATE FIELD OF THIS REPORT. THIS INCIDENT ALSO ACQUIRED LOCAL NEWS COVERAGE. /// ORIGINAL REPORT BELOW /// ****THIS IS AN UPDATE TO NRC REPORT # 1409840**** UPDATE IS AS FOLLOWS: - THE CALLER STATES THE SRP INFORMATION WAS INCORRECT, AND PROVIDED THE INFORMATION FOR THE CONTRACTING COMPANY. ORIGINAL REPORT CALLER STATES THAT A NATURAL GAS LINE WAS DAMAGED DUE TO A CONTRACTOR UTILIZING AN UNDERGROUND BULLET. WHILE BURROWING, THE OPERATOR PUNCTURED A PIPELINE, RELEASING NATURAL GAS INTO THE ATMOSPHERE. FOLLOWING THIS INCIDENT A STRUCTURE FIRE OCCURRED FOR UNKNOWN REASONS. 1647 - SECURED GAS 1922 - FIRE OUT; BLDG BURNED DOWN REASON FOR FIRE UNDER INVESTIGATION
